content: Where to mine next for rare earth: rank extraction candidates by LEADING indicators read from banked receipts, not by what feels elegant. Indicators: (1) hand-built category with highest actual session-cost multiplier (ground-truth verification ran 3x on PRL 1.1/1.2 and dominates 1.4's JTBD); (2) shared dependency in every projection's critical path (audience/PII gate - literal rare earth: small mass, in everything); (3) instance count >=2 with a third demanded (atlas). The prospecting function itself is the compounding asset: same move as the parked 1.3-1.5 re-pricing - compute the multiplier from the banked receipts at each close-loop, and let it point the next extraction.

content: Each projection factory graduates into a sovereign micro-service: independently invokable, owns its SSOT slice + gates, emits a typed print. Interop contract = the SPARK PLUG: every print carries a germination block (what it enables next, soil/triggers/care - same schema as the seed bank) so services compose potential->kinetic without a human re-deriving the handoff. Reference productization ladder (honest resume): profile scan FIRST (live: /scan/[scanId]) -> just-pdf -> enrich -> resume (contextual: conversation/interview/meeting-prep/agenda, internal/external/combo; resume-tailor v0.2 + resume-tailor.arcs.care live) -> blueprint + minimum-viable-artifact set -> pre-brief (potential, recoil-prep) -> spark -> de-brief (kinetic, recoil-close). People, process, tools, prints all addressable in the same composition.

content: Pollinate = the horizontal half of the seed lifecycle germinate lacks. Mechanics: (1) POLLEN GATE - strip the instance flesh (PII, tenant specifics) from a seed, keeping only class/invariant + germination conditions; the doll_export fail-closed gate is the existing implementation. (2) SOIL-AGNOSTIC PACKET - receiver re-derives soil/triggers/care for THEIR zero point; sender never prescribes it. (3) CARRIER - wind (public goods broadcast) or bee (hand-sent counterpart note); the carrier never self-sends. (4) PEDIGREE - landed pollen mints a NEW seed in the receiver's bank with dual lineage {parents: [seed-ids across tenants], carrier, landed_ts}; the _SEEDS schema's family/conforms_to fields extend to cross-tenant parentage. (5) OUT-CROSSING RULE - self-pollination is inbreeding depression (author-cosmology echo chamber); a healthy bank shows foreign parentage in its lineage graph.

triggers: a second tenant (kid, collaborator, counterpart) stands up their own seed bank -> pollinate becomes buildable, not just nameable

care: pollen gate is fail-closed and BLOCKING - genes cross, tissue never does
never prescribe the receiver's soil; vantage sovereignty is the point

conforms_to: ADR-068 (print/gate/fate) + sovereign-projection-services (spark plug on prints) + extraction-prospecting (rank from receipts) + magnetic-best-fit-annealing
content: A backlog whose items carry their own topography so plans are INDUCED, not composed. Item schema: jtbd + route (the tool/surface that verifiably reaches it, with verified_date - routes drift) + gates (blocking prints per ADR-068, incl. human-consent gates) + trigger (the spark plug: the precondition that flips it executable - a login appearing, a payment clearing, a reply arriving) + cost_prior (from banked receipts, re-priced by each execution's residue) + fates. Self-fulfilling in three senses: (1) when a trigger flips, execution is mechanical (no session replans it); (2) the sort is gravity (prospecting ranks by cost-receipts); (3) every execution prints receipts that re-price the remaining items - the backlog updates itself from its own residue. Proof instance: the 2026-08-19 Zapier co-pilot SSOT - 8 of 10 items executed across four different executors (inline MCP, browser, workflow agents, human) the moment topology was verified live, zero replanning. NOTOMATION guard: self-fulfilling never means self-authorizing - consent gates (list-first deletion, human sends, judgment calls) stay human even when everything around them is mechanical; the backlog induces execution, never consent.

soil: any open-items list currently living as prose (handoff next-actions, PENDING.md, snapshot.next_action)
triggers: a session picks up _QUEUE/induced-backlog.jsonl and executes an item purely from its stored route+gates without replanning -> the schema works
night-moves or the prospecting pass starts emitting the pull-list against it
care: verify routes live before executing (verify-domain-topology-live class)
every completed item gets a receipt line, every skipped gate is a drift receipt
re-price cost_priors from actuals at close, never re-guess

conforms_to: ADR-033 (closure is an explicit write; open-loop decay) + be-proactive-verify-with-tools-not-nag
content: Mechanical, read-only pulse check on every active counterpart loop: for each project_*.md memory file not marked CLOSED/STALLED, run a Gmail search (their addresses, both directions, newest message date) and compare against the memory file's newest recorded action date. Inbox-ahead-of-memory = a drift line ('Robin replied Aug-26; memory last records Aug-6'). Optionally sweep calendar for booked events with the counterpart. Output = receipt lines only; judgment (re-warm, close, update) stays human. Proven need 2026-08-26: all three 'stale warm loops' flagged by the archive sweep were wrong in the same pessimistic direction (Robin had closed-warm in writing, Yuri had inverted to reciprocal + booked a 1-1, only Ahmed was truly quiet) because closures and inbounds land in the inbox while memory files sleep.

triggers: next /night-moves run adds a 'counterpart pulse' section
any session about to act on a loop's staleness (check pulse BEFORE re-warming or closing)

receipt lines name the evidence (thread id + date), never a verdict
counterparts marked CLOSED/STALLED are skipped unless inbound detected - inbound on a closed loop is its own high-signal line

conforms_to: [[inlier-run-the-falsifying-test-before-confident-claim]] (degeneracy only visible in aggregate) + reach-metadata (a tag carries its own reach: source/confidence/informative-or-stub) + [[build-reusable-decomposable-interoperable-default]]
content: Atomic informativeness/degeneracy auditor. Given a tagged corpus, flag signals that are PRESENT but CONTENTLESS - constant across the corpus (<=1 distinct value-tuple), the INLIER class invisible to per-row presence/null checks, visible only in aggregate. Enforces reach-metadata: a categorization's reach must declare informative-vs-stub, not just present-vs-null. Prototype LIVE in run_real_receipts.run() (the corpus-level distinct-value pass); exec-verified on 247 real receipts, where it caught the SAGE somatic/axioms inlier (1 distinct across 45) that presence checks rated 45-real. GERMINATION: extract the corpus pass into a standalone service (records, field-spec) -> per-field {present, distinct, degenerate, informativeness}. Reusable across every ARCS categorization layer (DEWY / NCI / archetypes / Y-gate / operator verdicts) and OSS-able as a general data-quality primitive (a distinct-value/variance pass that catches degenerate-but-present features which pass null-checks). TRIGGER: a second consumer beyond the audit harness.

conforms_to: reach-metadata + JTBD-F (RAG kernel-discovery, unbuilt) + canon-collision-escalate discipline + /catalog (tool-recommender pattern) + [[opposing-abductive-folksonomy-vs-taxonomy-overfit]]
content: The librarian/recommender: proactively surface the nearest EXISTING canon (ADR / axiom / ROM primitive / memory / ledger entry) at the moment of need, BEFORE a mint or a decision, so you consult the map before re-deriving or colliding. The archive (corpus / atlas / ziggurat / canon) is PASSIVE today - it holds the books but has no agency to RECOMMEND them; consultation is manual (grep) or human-prompted. SESSION EVIDENCE (2026-09-02): 4+ near-mints each collided with existing canon (thinking-vs-knowing=Hyperstition#3; premise-law=clarity_before_curvature+Golden-Inchworm; static-regime=Inductive-overfit; deceipt-ledger=falsification-ledger+SUPERSEDED) and each was caught only by manual grep or a human prompt, never by the librarian. The pattern EXISTS for tools (/catalog picks 1 of 131); the CANON analog + GIGI/RAG kernel-discovery (JTBD-F) are unbuilt. COMPANION to informativeness-auditor: the auditor DETECTS what is degenerate in NEW work; the librarian RECOMMENDS what is already-right in the ARCHIVE. GERMINATION: given a candidate claim/mint/decision, return the nearest existing canon with an overlap/collision score - the canon-collision gate made PROACTIVE instead of manual. TRIGGER: the recurring cost of re-derivation/near-collision.

conforms_to: WORLD.md backcountry-avalanche (hidden weak layers = ruin; safe-travel = Y-gate+BAR) + ADR-033 (SUPERSEDED markers, never silent-delete) + reach-metadata + the etymology receipt/deceipt (capere siblings)
content: The ACCOUNTANT: double-entry knowledge bookkeeping WITH a ruin overlay. (1) DOUBLE-ENTRY - receipts=assets (frozen knowing), deceipts=liabilities (false-positives/inliers/discovered-untruths). A discovered-false receipt is MOVED asset->liability (carried, re-examined for pathogen-in-disguise), never silently deleted (extends the falsification ledger + SUPERSEDED discipline into a balance sheet; net epistemic position = assets - liabilities). (2) RUIN OVERLAY - the liabilities RENDER onto the Terrain-Atlas ziggurat as HAZARD markers on the strata they infect, so an ascent is RISK-ADJUSTED by default (the avalanche-forecast layer WORLD.md already specifies but the atlas does not yet render: strata are mapped, weak-layers are not). Completes the triad the auditor and librarian belong to: AUDITOR detects the ruin (informativeness-auditor) -> ACCOUNTANT logs it double-entry AND marks it on the map -> LIBRARIAN recommends the right existing book (canon-recommender). GERMINATION: a ledger with an asset/liability move + an atlas render pass that draws deceipts as weak-layer/hazard glyphs on the ziggurat. TRIGGER: a deceipt discovered (this session: the '45 evidence-backed' - already moved, not deleted, but not yet rendered as a hazard on the map).

conforms_to: read-only static tripwire; PTV-01..07 abstracted from DPRK Contagious Interview (G1052); stdlib-only, no network/exec; exit-code CI gate
content: A read-only scanner that flags malicious install-time/open-time payload triggers in an untrusted repo BEFORE it is opened or installed (the 'opening the folder is the exploit' class). Abstracts the Contagious Interview trigger chain into reusable pattern-threat-vectors: PTV-01 folderOpen task, PTV-02 npm lifecycle hooks, PTV-03 curl|bash, PTV-04 server-driven eval, PTV-05 process.env exfil, PTV-06 obfuscated appended line, PTV-07 known-bad IOC/:1224. Inert by construction (reads files; never installs/execs/evals/networks), so it is safe on the very thing it inspects. Proven on a matched fixture pair (evil exit 2, benign exit 0). Public-good candidate: genuinely useful to any developer/CI independent of ARCS; the ARCS tie-in is the pattern-threat-vector doctrine and the orthogonal-echo lineage (provenance-before-execution invariant).

soil: any dev/CI adding untrusted deps or receiving recruiter/take-home repos; the detection bundle in analysis/detections/ is the live campaign instance
triggers: a second campaign's IOCs get loaded via --iocs -> the abstraction (PTV over literals) proves it generalizes
a full skill-creator eval loop runs the evil/benign fixtures + trigger-optimization -> ready to atomize into a public repo
care: stays read-only and network-free forever; the day it executes what it scans, it becomes the threat
heuristic not sandbox: a clean result never means 'safe', only 'no known pattern fired'
tune PTV-02 for legit husky/build prepare hooks before hard-failing CI

conforms_to: worktree-isolated multi-session fan-out; pre-serialized disjoint write-scope + single-owner shared files; append-only shared ledger; per-lane specialized peer review; human-merges; orchestrator vets scope-bleed. NOTOMATION-safe (mechanical fan-out auto, judgment human).
content: Puppet-master fan-out as a public good: a skill/CLI that scaffolds N concurrent JTBD as N spawn_task sessions, each in its OWN git worktree+branch (structural anti-clobber), each carrying a pre-serialized plan naming the files it OWNS and forbidding the rest, with any shared file assigned a single owner (others go read-mostly and flag findings) and any shared ledger append-only. Each lane runs its own specialized peer reviewer and opens a PR; the human merges (consent stays human); the orchestrating session designs the lanes and vets scope-bleed on return, never merging. Sibling to token-savings-bank in the OSS family. The genuinely-useful abstraction independent of ARCS: safe parallelism across AI coding sessions on one repo without whole-file clobbers, which git's non-ff lock does NOT prevent.

soil: any team running multiple concurrent AI coding sessions on one repo; anyone burned by a parallel-session whole-file clobber (git's non-ff lock misses it)
triggers: a second real fan-out (>=3 lanes) returns zero cross-lane bleed -> the model generalizes beyond the Reading Room proof
the scope-bleed vet + append-only-ledger union become a runnable script -> ready to atomize into a public skill
care: worktree isolation is load-bearing: in-process subagents or a shared branch reintroduce the clobber
single-owner-per-shared-file is the rule that makes it safe; a union auto-resolve is valid ONLY for append-only ledgers, never code
the orchestrator must NOT self-merge or auto-promote to canon (NOTOMATION)

lab_candidate.note: proven once (Reading Room 1a/1b/1c: 3 worktree-isolated lanes, 3 clean returns, zero cross-lane bleed); not yet packaged; the vet + union-resolve steps are the atomizable core
